title: Brambleskin rank 20
problem: Brambleskin rank 20: additional damage = 10% of the damage the bearer has taken this battle (code: 10% x damage x turns taken)
notes: Details: research/handoff_eval.md 2026-10-26 clarification for the user: the unpatched code is bonus = 0.1 x this hit x the bearer's battleturns (a per-turn ramp, no damage-taken term at all; almost certainly the wrong variable). Patched: 0.1 x the bearer's damage_taken. Remaining gap: when the Relic object itself attacks, the patch reads the Relic's own damage_taken (likely 0) instead of the bearer's; the text ('this relic and its bearer') needs a hook to read the bearer's total. Tracked here. 2026-10-26: gap closed with hook_su0083_varget (relic attacks read relic.owner.damage_taken).

release_notes.intended: The relic and its bearer deal additional damage equal to 10% of the damage the bearer has taken this battle.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the bonus was 10% of the current hit for each turn the bearer had taken, unrelated to damage taken.
release_notes.fix: Now the bonus is 10% of the damage the bearer has taken, for both the bearer's and the relic's attacks.
